blocks.prompt: 7 A rocket follows the height function \(h(t) = -5t^2 + 20t + 30\), where \(h(t)\) is the height in metres and \(t\) is the time in seconds. Find the time interval during which the rocket is at least 40 metres above the ground.
blocks.explanation:
Yeh bhi word problem hai jo quadratic inequality ban jata hai.
Diya kya hai? Rocket ki unchai \(h(t) = -5t^2 + 20t + 30\) metre, jahan \(t\) seconds mein waqt hai.
Find kya karna hai? Woh waqt ka interval jab rocket kam az kam 40 metre ki unchai par ho.
Plan: \(h(t) \geq 40\) likhna, ek taraf zero, \(-5\) se divide (nishan ulta), critical numbers aur sahi region.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(h(t) = -5t^2 + 20t + 30\) metre, waqt \(t\) seconds.
Humein find karna hai: \(t\) ka interval jahan \(h(t) \geq 40\).
Tareeqa: "At least 40 metres" (kam az kam 40) ka matlab 40 ya zyada, yani \(\geq\). Quadratic inequality ko critical numbers (jahan expression zero ho) ki madad se solve karenge.

Inequality likhein
\[-5t^2 + 20t + 30 \geq 40\]
\[-5t^2 + 20t - 10 \geq 0\]
Kyun: Dono taraf se 40 minus kiya taake right side zero ho jaye; sign ka faisla zero ke muqable mein aasaan hota hai.

\(-5\) se divide karein
\[t^2 - 4t + 2 \leq 0\]
Kyun: Negative number se divide karne par inequality ka nishan ulta ho jata hai: \(\geq\) ab \(\leq\) ban gaya. Misaal: \(2 < 3\), lekin \(-2 > -3\).
Dhyan dein: yahan nishan na palatna is sawal ki sab se bari ghalti hai; us se jawab bilkul ulta region aa jata hai.

Critical numbers nikalein
\[t = \dfrac{4 \pm \sqrt{16 - 8}}{2}\]
\[= \dfrac{4 \pm 2\sqrt{2}}{2} = 2 \pm \sqrt{2}\]
\[t \approx 0.586 \text{ or } t \approx 3.414\]
Kyun: \(a = 1, b = -4, c = 2\) ke saath quadratic formula. \(\sqrt{8} = \sqrt{4 \times 2} = 2\sqrt{2}\), aur \(\sqrt{2} \approx 1.414\).

Sahi region chunein
\[2 - \sqrt{2} \leq t \leq 2 + \sqrt{2}\]
\[0.586 \leq t \leq 3.414\]
Kyun: \(t^2 - 4t + 2\) ka \(t^2\) coefficient positive hai, to graph U shakal ka hai aur roots ke darmiyan negative (yani \(\leq 0\)). Dono roots positive hain, is liye waqt \(t \geq 0\) wali shart se kuch nahi badalta.

Tasdeeq
\[t = 2:\ h = -20 + 40 + 30 = 50 \geq 40 \;\checkmark\]
\[t = 0:\ h = 30 < 40\]
Kyun: Interval ke andar (\(t = 2\)) rocket 50 m par hai, 40 se upar. Bahar (\(t = 0\), launch ke waqt) 30 m par hai. Kinaron par (\(t = 2 \pm \sqrt{2}\)) unchai theek 40 m hai. Yani rocket taqreeban 2.83 seconds tak 40 m se upar rehta hai.
blocks.final_answer: \(2 - \sqrt{2} \leq t \leq 2 + \sqrt{2}\), yani taqreeban 0.586 s se 3.414 s tak
